svg.title: Simple self-attention for the token journey (x squared), with formulas and a worked example for the token one (x fifth) at each step.
svg.desc: Four steps top to bottom: inputs, dot-product scores, softmax weights, and weighted sum giving context vector z squared = 0.44, 0.65, 0.57. Each step shows its formula and a worked example.
svg.text: Building the context vector z⁽²⁾ step by step
Each token is a 3-number vector. The example below traces x⁽⁵⁾ (“one”).
query = x⁽²⁾ (“journey”), shown in purple — compared against all inputs
Step 2 · Calc attention scores · Dot product: ω₂ᵢ = x⁽²⁾ · x⁽ⁱ⁾
Dot the query with each input, element-wise then summed. Larger = more aligned.
Step 3 · Calc attention weights · Softmax: α₂ᵢ = softmax(ω₂)ᵢ
Exponentiate each score, divide by the total. Weights are positive and sum to 1.
Step 4 · Calc context vector · Weighted sum: z⁽²⁾ = Σ α₂ᵢ · x⁽ⁱ⁾
One row per loop pass. Each pass scales a whole token vector and adds it into the running total.

g.text: context_vec_2 += attn_weights_2[i] * x_i # add one scaled vector

svg.text: ↑ after the last += , this is z⁽²⁾
